title: エンディング（ノーマル）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My first three years with Yaeno Muteki have come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has achieved great success in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I believe she's grown physically and mentally as a result of her battles against numerous rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Master!
choice_data_list: Hello! I hope you don't mind my being here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: I wasn't aware that you were visiting, Trainer. Please forgive me for not being prepared.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: So, what brings you here today?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We've passed the three-year mark in the Twinkle Series, so we've come to inform you of our progress.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've undergone many races while holding the Kongo Yaegaki principle of blaze fierce, water still in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, the Twinkle Series was replete with powerful opponents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I could sense my limits as I pitted my own weak-willed self against stalwart adversaries.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But even in the face of mighty foes, I refused to yield. My raging emotions pined for the top.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win. I wanted to defeat everyone, prevail over the one who presided at the top, and attain the glory of being the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And to sate my thirst for victory…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I made the decision to go beyond our teachings and give in to my emotions, changing my competitive drive into a source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …In doing so, I went against the Kongo Yaegaki teaching that dictates one must suppress one's desire for recognition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I emphasize how I think she made the right decision and that it was a necessary move for her to defeat her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Trainer has led me on the right path, as a trainer should.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I personally have no regrets about unleashing my blazing emotions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However… despite my desire to show you and Grandmother my growth through the Twinkle Series…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My inability to abandon my desire for acknowledgement has only proved that I haven't grown at all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry for having besmirched the reputation of the Kongo Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's grandfather takes in everything she says without comment. After some contemplation, he finally breaks the silence.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Hm… What about you, Trainer? Do you think Yaeno has failed to grow?
choice_data_list: I don't think that at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Throughout the last three years, Yaeno Muteki has continually strived to win despite the variety of obstacles she's encountered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not to mention she's triumphed over many a mighty adversary. What is that if not a sign of growth!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: I agree. To fully embrace one's weakness without averting one's gaze from it is also a form of growth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Master!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: I've watched Yaeno's running for the past three years. For that reason, I'm well aware of where her growth stems from.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: And knowing all that, I must say—Yaeno, you've done well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Gramp—I mean Mast—Grampaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Overcome with emotion and shedding tears of happiness, Yaeno Muteki throws herself into her grandfather's loving arms.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Thank you so much for everything these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's thanks to you that I was able to show Grampa and everyone else that I've grown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But as you know, I still have much to learn. I'll likely require further guidance as I continue on this journey.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Will you continue to accompany me on my path?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Great! Then I shall be counting on you for many years to come!
